Hmm I think there are two problems which we will run into when rendering dividers:
- It looks like our markdown parser dependency (pulldown_cmark) does not pickup dividers if there is no line break before and after the `---`, see https://www.markdownguide.org/basic-syntax/#horizontal-rule-best-practices. Github is able to render that though
- The markdown crate renders everything into an `InteractiveText` element, which does not support inserting elements other than text. We could 'split' up blocks [here](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/blob/db73bb9e3080205b018ed38fd31b52cd83e93080/crates/editor/src/editor.rs#L152) and render dividers, however at this point it would probably make the most sense to combine the `language` markdown implementation with the `markdown_preview` markdown implementation (which does support lists, tables, dividers, etc.)

Isn't that YAML frontmatter? YAML frontmatter is supposed to only show up at the start of a text (see [here](https://jekyllrb.com/docs/front-matter/)) and "must take the form of valid YAML set between triple-dashed lines".

issue_context.title: Missing newline or whitespace in variable hover popover
issue_context.body: ### Check for existing issues - [X] Completed ### Describe the bug / provide steps to reproduce it When hovering a symbol, in the `variable x` context popover, after the `provided by "header.h"` text, there appears to be a missing newline or whitespace. Right now, the `provided by "header.h"` text runs directly into the following `Type: ` section, which looks like it should be on the next line, to align with the `Value = ` text. Right now, you will have something like: ``` variable x provided by "header.h"Type: uint32_t Value = 123 ``` Which should probably be: ``` variable x provided by "header.h" Type: uint32_t Value = 123 ``` Also, minor note, but the capitalization, punctuation, and spacing of these elements is also inconsistent. `Type: ` is capitalized and using a colon, while `variable` and `provided by` are not capitalized and have no punctuation, and `Value = ` is capitalized with an equals sign, and there appears to be an extra empty line after `Value =`. If these were all normalized: ``` Variable: x Provided by: "header.h" Type: uint32_t Value: 123 // Definition ``` ### Environment Zed: v0.130.6 (Zed) OS: macOS 11.7.2 Memory: 16 GiB Architecture: aarch64 ### If applicable, add mockups / screenshots to help explain present your vision of the feature ``` Variable: tty_uart Provided by: "uart.h" Type: 'UART_HandleTypeDef (aka struct __UART_HandleTypeDef)' Value: '&tty_uart' extern UART_HandleTypeDef tty_uart ``` or ``` variable tty_uart provided by "uart.h" Type: 'UART_HandleTypeDef (aka struct __UART_HandleTypeDef)' Value = '&tty_uart' extern UART_HandleTypeDef tty_uart ``` ### If applicable, attach your `~/Library/Logs/Zed/Zed.log` file to this issue. _No response_
